root.title: Act4Cap Integrated Downscaling & Environmental Routine Configuration
root.description: GENERATED from config/knobs.json by tools/gen_config.R. Executes Cascading Gamble spatial downscaling across EU-27 for selected macro models (GLOBIOM, CAPRI, IMAGE, MAGNET, CLUMONDO), followed by SWAT+ water quality simulations and Biodiversity Link ecological metrics in a cluster container environment. Entrypoint: entrypoint.sh.

TASK.title: Workflow / Task
TASK.description: Workflow / Task -- Which workflow task to run: 'trial' executes a fast trial verification run proving the container, mounts, and interfaces; 'downscale' executes the necessary spatial mediation allocating macro economic targets to 10km grid cells with exact mass conservation; 'swat' runs the SWAT+ water model post-processor; 'biodiversity' runs the Biodiversity Link post-processor; 'postprocess' runs SWAT+ and Biodiversity Link side-by-side on mediated downscaling results; 'all' runs the complete pipeline (downscaling mediation + SWAT+ + Biodiversity Link).

MACRO_MODEL.title: Macro Economic Model(s)
MACRO_MODEL.description: Macro Economic Model(s) -- Which macro-economic model(s) to process: single model ('globiom'), comma-separated models ('globiom,capri'), or 'all' to process all models in parallel across allocated CPU cores.

INPUT_FILE.title: Macro Model Input File / Vintage
INPUT_FILE.description: Macro Model Input File / Vintage -- Specific macro-economic data filename or path to process (e.g. '20260916_compr_scens_merge.csv'). If left empty or set to 'latest', the orchestrator automatically detects and selects the newest date vintage available in the macro_model folder. OPTIONAL: leave empty for the built-in default.

POSTMODELS.title: Subprocessing Environmental Models
POSTMODELS.description: Subprocessing Environmental Models -- Which subprocessing / post-modelling modules to run side-by-side: 'all' (both SWAT+ and Biodiversity Link), 'swat' (water quality only), 'biodiversity' (ecological intactness only), or 'none'.

SCENARIO.title: Macro / Policy Scenario(s)
SCENARIO.description: Macro / Policy Scenario(s) -- Scenario(s) to evaluate: 'base' runs the baseline reference path; 'all' runs all standard scenarios (base, mitigation, diet, biodiversity); or pass comma-separated scenarios (e.g. 'base,mitigation'). Multiple scenarios are executed in parallel across allocated CPU cores.

RUN_SWAT.title: Run Water Quality Model (SWAT+)
RUN_SWAT.description: Run Water Quality Model (SWAT+) -- Whether to run SWAT+ water quality simulations (nutrient runoff, nitrogen and phosphorus leaching, streamflow, catchment sediment yield). Set to 1 for on, 0 for off.

RUN_BIODIVERSITY.title: Run Biodiversity Model (Biodiversity Link)
RUN_BIODIVERSITY.description: Run Biodiversity Model (Biodiversity Link) -- Whether to run the Biodiversity Link ecological effects model (species richness, Mean Species Abundance MSA, habitat fragmentation, ecosystem intactness). Set to 1 for on, 0 for off.

YEARS.title: Time Horizon / Years
YEARS.description: Time Horizon / Years -- Simulation years to process. 'all' downscales and simulates all standard time steps (2000, 2010, 2020, 2030, 2040, 2050); or pass comma-separated years.

RESOLUTION.title: Grid Spatial Resolution
RESOLUTION.description: Grid Spatial Resolution -- Target grid resolution for downscaling and subsequent impact assessment. Standard Act4Cap grid is 10km (EEA EPSG:3035).

NCORES.title: Parallel CPU Cores
NCORES.description: Parallel CPU Cores -- Number of CPU cores allocated for parallel raster processing, IPF gravity allocation, and catchment-level environmental calculations.

TRIAL.title: Fast Trial Run Mode
TRIAL.description: Fast Trial Run Mode -- Set to 1 to run a fast trial run over a regional slice, verifying container environment, mounts, and interfaces without full computation. Set to 0 for production.

FORCE.title: Force Re-run Existing Outputs
FORCE.description: Force Re-run Existing Outputs -- Set to 1 to force re-computation and overwrite existing outputs on the drive. Left at 0 to resume from completed stages.

RUN_DATE.title: Run Date / Version Date
RUN_DATE.description: Run Date / Version Date -- Date label used in output directories and filenames (e.g. '20261103'). If left empty, automatically defaults to the current system date (YYYYMMDD). OPTIONAL: leave empty for the built-in default.

VERSION_TAG.title: Custom Output Version Tag
VERSION_TAG.description: Custom Output Version Tag -- Optional additional version label or run identifier appended to all output directories and filenames (e.g. 'v1', 'deliv3', 'exp_test'). OPTIONAL: leave empty for the built-in default.

WORK_DIR.title: Persistent Storage Mount (FUSE)
WORK_DIR.description: Persistent Storage Mount (FUSE) -- The cluster FUSE mount path where persistent inputs and outputs are symlinked so the platform retains and collects them at job completion.

OUTPUT_DIR.title: Output Subdirectory
OUTPUT_DIR.description: Output Subdirectory -- Directory where downscaled land use, GeoTIFF indicators, SWAT+ outputs, and Biodiversity Link metrics are written.

INPUT_DIR.title: Input Subdirectory
INPUT_DIR.description: Input Subdirectory -- Directory containing macro model tabular data, baseline spatial maps, prior weights, and catchment boundary shapefiles.

CASCADING_GAMBLE_DIR.title: Cascade Spatial Mediator Path
CASCADING_GAMBLE_DIR.description: Cascade Spatial Mediator Path -- Filesystem path to the Cascade downscaling suite acting as the necessary spatial mediator between macro models and environmental post-processors (gamble-cascade / cascadinggamble-core).

SWATPLUS_DIR.title: SWAT+ Toolkit Directory
SWATPLUS_DIR.description: SWAT+ Toolkit Directory -- Path to the SWAT+ Python scripts (0-6), default HRU shapefile, and model binaries (e.g. Q:/swatplus_runs locally or /mnt/wdrv/act4cap/swatplus_runs on WKUBE).

BIODIVERSITY_LINK_DIR.title: Biodiversity Link Repository Path
BIODIVERSITY_LINK_DIR.description: Biodiversity Link Repository Path -- Path to the IIASA Biodiversity_Link codebase and input datasets (commit 6cc4443f24663622cbbae6f22dce5428bce6b50d).

BIODIVERSITY_MAPPING_FILE.title: AgMIP to Biodiversity Link Mapping Table
BIODIVERSITY_MAPPING_FILE.description: AgMIP to Biodiversity Link Mapping Table -- Path to CSV table defining the formal crosswalk between downscaled AgMIP land-use classes and IIASA Biodiversity Link categories (lc_type, lc_btc, lc_csar, bii_luclass, csar affinity, and msa).

POSTMODEL_MODE.title: Post-Modelling Execution Mode
POSTMODEL_MODE.description: Post-Modelling Execution Mode -- Execution mode for post-models: 'tentative' runs integrated analytical post-processing with graceful fallbacks; 'full' executes native cluster simulation pipelines; 'trial' executes rapid verification proof.
